title: City Council District 9
statement: Laurel and Uptown are holding steady. With no proposals in play and no pressing conditions on my turf, there's no urgent need for me to force a move this cycle. I'm watching the sick-resident counts in both neighborhoods — Laurel at 111, Uptown at 23 — and I'll stay ready to act if those numbers trend the wrong way. Sometimes the right call is to hold the line and let good work continue without interference.
